recipe.subject: A short iron dagger tilted toward the left with one small solid orange curved slash mark. The slash is a single opaque flat shape with crisp filled edges; no white trail, glow, translucent edges or scattered pixels.

style.prompt: Create one intuitive fantasy skill icon on a transparent background. Use a 64x64 logical pixel grid with crisp stepped edges and large solid color blocks. Use a compact palette of 8-12 solid colors at most; each material has only one base color and at most one shadow color. Center one dominant subject filling about 75 percent of the canvas, with at most one simple action or effect. Keep the silhouette readable at 32x32. No text, letters, numbers, frame, border, scenery, texture, thin lines, metallic reflections, shine, glow, gradients, particles, or dense detail. Deliberately simple and restrained.

skill.name: 副手斩击
skill.description: 使用副手单手武器进行次要攻击；消耗 2 AP，基础伤害为主手斩击的 70%，应用副手武器倍率与属性要求。
